source: Hand verdicts by the data lead, 2026-09-13, comparing the Forever text in data/races/*.json against the Classic Era racial the same name denotes.
why: racials.json holds paraphrases written from memory, so a machine text diff can only say 'the wording differs', which is true of every entry and therefore useless. These verdicts are the judgement a reader would make, recorded once so the pipeline can attach it. Every one of them is unverified: replace the lot as soon as a sourced Classic racial list or a DB2 dump exists.

statuses.same: the effect is the Classic one; only the wording was modernised
statuses.changed: the effect itself differs (numbers, resources or mechanics)

perception.note: Classic also detects stealth for 20 sec; wording modernised

sword-specialization.note: Classic gives +5 sword weapon skill; Forever gives 2% spell and ability critical chance

stoneform.note: Classic removes bleed, poison and disease and adds 10% armor; Forever grants immunity to them and reduces physical damage taken

find-treasure.note: minimap treasure tracking in both; Classic is a toggle

shadowmeld.note: stealth while standing still in both

quickness.note: Classic is 1% dodge only; Forever adds 2% run speed

wisp-spirit.note: Classic 50% run speed while dead, Forever 75%

escape-artist.note: Classic escapes an active root or snare; Forever grants a brief immunity to them

expansive-mind.note: Classic is +5% Intellect; Forever is +5% maximum Mana, Rage or Energy, so it works for every class

engineering-specialization.note: Classic is +15 Engineering skill; Forever makes engineering devices more reliable

blood-fury.note: Classic gives flat, level-scaled melee attack power and reduces healing taken; Forever gives 10% Attack Power and Spell Power with no healing penalty in the text

axe-specialization.note: Classic gives +5 axe weapon skill; Forever gives 1% spell and ability critical chance

hardiness.note: Classic reduces stun duration by 25%, Forever by 20%

will-of-the-forsaken.note: Classic is a 5 sec immunity to Charm, Fear and Sleep on a 2 min cooldown; Forever removes those effects, with no immunity window in the text

cannibalize.note: Classic restores health only; Forever restores 35% Health and Mana

war-stomp.note: 2 sec stun on nearby enemies in both; Classic caps it at 5 targets

cultivation.note: Classic is +15 Herbalism skill; Forever grows bonus herbs that need no Herbalism at all

endurance.note: Classic is +5% base health; Forever adds 1% Hit Chance

berserking.note: Classic scales from 10% to 30% with missing health; Forever is a flat 10%

regeneration.note: Classic is +10% health regeneration of which 10% continues in combat; Forever keeps only the in-combat clause

beast-slaying.note: 5% more damage to beasts in both
